items.name: TableSchema
items.summary: The overall schema for potentially partitioned data sources.

methods.name: builder
methods.summary: Start building a [`TableSchema`] from its (required) file schema.

methods.name: file_schema
methods.summary: Get the file schema (without partition columns).

methods.name: from_file_schema
methods.summary: Create a new TableSchema with no partition columns.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(file_schema: SchemaRef, table_partition_cols: Vec<FieldRef>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new TableSchema from a file schema and partition columns.

methods.name: schema_without_virtual_columns
methods.summary: Schema of columns that can be referenced by predicates pushed into the file reader: file columns plus partition columns, excluding virtual columns.

methods.name: table_schema
methods.summary: Get the full table schema (file schema + partition columns + virtual columns).

methods.name: with_table_partition_cols
methods.summary: Return a new `TableSchema` with `partition_cols` as its partition columns, replacing any existing ones. Existing virtual columns are preserved.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Build the [`TableSchema`], computing the full `file + partition + virtual` schema once.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a builder for a `TableSchema` over the given file schema, with no partition or virtual columns yet.

methods.name: with_table_partition_cols
methods.signature: fn with_table_partition_cols(self, table_partition_cols: impl Into<Fields>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the partition columns, replacing any previously set.

methods.summary: Set the virtual columns, replacing any previously set.
